FM1.

MIDI CONTROLLER

Plug in a keyboard or pad controller. Its keys play the FM-1. Its knobs and pads start on the FM-1's knobs and buttons, and DEVICE shows a drawing of it where you can change any of them, and MAP learns your controller step by step (keys, pads, knobs, sustain, bend, transport). Knobs 1 to 4 are the FM-1's left knobs and 5 to 8 its right ones; the pads are its buttons. The sustain pedal is a MOD key: while it is held, the pads and knobs become a second set (pad 9 up). The MOD button turns that on or off.

Not connected yet.

THE APP

REAL FM-1

Connect a real FM-1 with a USB cable (Chrome or Edge, a computer or an Android phone; not iPhone). It can play along with this one, and this page can back up its flash and install firmwares on it. Do the steps in order and read what each one says.

Not connected yet.

THANK YOU, JOAKIM

FM1.Pocket is a fork of fm1-emu by Joakim Eriksson.

The whole emulated FM-1 inside (its CPU, flash, screen, keys, knobs and sound) is his work, used unchanged. This app adds a phone-first front to it, a mapper for MIDI controllers and installation as an app.
